Tutorial plateau and northern town.

Six sectors · four plateau, two town · natural stone arches and timber access

Northwest — Tutorial 4Northeast — Tutorial 3Southwest — Tutorial 2Southeast · start — Tutorial 1Northwest town — Tutorial 5Northeast town — Tutorial 6

All levels are visible. Choose edit level 1 for ground routes, 2 for the small arch top, 3 for the lower shelf, or 5 for the plateau summit. Use Overview to inspect an entire sector. Ground is layer 1; two doubled cliff tiers rise four height steps.

The original filled colours are unchanged: dark green is ground; light green is the summit. Tan shows the lower cliff tier, including the two new shapes in sector 5. The upper tier curves into the southern shape. Grey roads are six tiles wide, centred east–west with a north branch.

The large arch placement remains reserved for finished asset integration. The layout is a full 2 × 3 rectangle: town 5/6, plateau 4/3, plateau 2/1. Sector 5 keeps the original cliff approach and adds a three-tile timber descent. A natural stone arch with its top on playable layer 4 spans its six-tile road with one clear tile on either side. Sector 6 has the matching one-level footpath arch. The small arch’s top and timber approaches are playable now. The large arch and its approaches remain reserved for the finished art integration. The artist’s finished stone assets will replace the integration placeholders. Buildings, encounters and campaign transitions remain to be authored.
